Let me analyze these teaching examples carefully to identify systematic errors in the forecasts compared to true outcomes.

Looking at the data patterns:

## Example 1 (2025-08-05)
- History: Price started around 70.74 and moved to 71.55 on day 1 of the 30-day forecast
- Model forecasted: 71.55 on day 1
- True outcome: 71.59 on day 1 (very close, no error)
- But looking at the divergence pattern...
